title: Welcome to the COSY Editorial & Learning Corner
dek: Welcome to our editorial room! Explore personal journal notes, language learning philosophies, and canonical curriculum guides across all 14 COSY target languages.

blocks.text: Welcome to the official COSY Editorial & Learning Corner!

Here at COSYlanguages, we believe in **speaking-first, immersion-based pedagogy**. Language learning is not about memorizing abstract tables in isolation; it is about connecting with real people and communicating authentically from day one.

items: **100% Free & Open Access:** All learning materials, practice tools, and reference guides are freely accessible to learners worldwide.
**No-Translation Immersion:** Direct target-language immersion supported by contextual visual cues.
**CELTA-Aligned Standard:** Methodologically structured for real communicative competence.

blocks.text: Stay tuned for regular updates, pedagogical insights, and deep dives into language acquisition!
